question:
The bar graph provided below shows the revenue earned by a company in 2015 and 2016 from different types, such as P, Q, R, S, and T, represented by the number of cell phones (in lakhs). Please read the graph carefully and then answer the questions given

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/88ff7c0070b400a614a82e7c9f33a17004355f5b021a30a7c16bd7f47a8d269c.png] 

Note: Types of cellphones - Types of cell phones; Number of units imported (in lakhs) - Number of units imported (in lakhs). Which type of cellphone has experienced the lowest percentage change (increase or decrease) in the number of units imported from 2015 to 2016?
solution:
**Given:**

Data from the bar graph for the number of cell phones (in lakhs) imported in 2015 and 2016:

P: 25 (2015), 30 (2016)

Q: 28 (2015), 32 (2016)

R: 30 (2015), 28 (2016)

S: 34 (2015), 36 (2016)

T: 26 (2015), 20 (2016)

**Formula used:**

Percentage change = frac{{New Value} - {Old Value}}{{Old Value}} times 100</
